text:
Maya R.: Quick async check — postmortem for INC-932 action list landed in the doc. Need someone to cover weekend mitigations and be the RCA liaison for other teams. See doc: https://redwood.in/rca/INC-932
Alex T.: I can take liaison for infra-migrations, will update the doc with my name and a short plan by EOD. @Maya R. do you want a separate runbook for the weekend?
Maya R.: Yes please add a 1-2 step runbook (rollback, temp throttling) and a `contact` section. Keep it minimal.
Sophie Li: I can own the monitoring followups and alerts tuning tomorrow morning. I'll add a Prometheus rule tweak and test canary.
Samir: I'll do the on-call weekend coverage in rotation, but need someone to pair on the first hour of Saturday to hand off the state. @Alex T. you good to join 9–10am PT?
Alex T.: Yup 9–10am PT works. I'll add calendar invite and link to the runbook.
Ryan C.: FYI I posted a short patch to revert the last deploy in case we need it: `git revert 4f2a8b1`. Tested locally. @Samir add it to the rollback steps.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-932 status changed: mitigated -> monitoring. Pinged @oncall on Slack.
Maya R.: Awesome. Final asks: 1) Add your name + ETA in the doc, 2) add the rollback snippet under 'Runbook', 3) set a followup for Monday for root-cause writeup. I'll compile owners and send to PMs by 18:00.
Sophie Li: Done (added monitoring owner + alert thresholds).
Alex T.: Runbook + calendar created. Invite sent.
Samir: I'll be on call Sat morning and will join the handoff. Put me in the doc.
Ryan C.: Patch uploaded to staging; I'll stand by to cut it to prod if we need.
Maya R.: thanks all :heart: I'll close the loop tomorrow noon. If anything changes, @here update the doc and ping me.
